g.text: Cart · The four operations and their conflicts
Cart is exclusive to the customer role.
Manager and courier get 403 on all four
An empty cart is empty items and a zero subtotal,
not a 404: the active cart always exists
[The SKU doesn't exist or its product is deactivated]
The two conflicts are told apart by the remedy:
waiting helps the first and never the second
[That SKU was already in the cart]
A second line for the same SKU is never created
front never needs a second call to refresh the subtotal.
The trade-off: cartItemId travels bare in the route. If the
service doesn't check that the line belongs to the caller's
